actionmax.us.title: Body at Brighton Rock
actionmax.us.description: Wendy, a part-time summer employee at a mountainous state park, takes on a rough trail assignment at the end of the season, trying to prove to her friends that she's capable enough to do the job. When she takes a wrong turn and ends up deep in the backcountry, she stumbles upon what might be a potential crime scene. Stuck with no communication after losing her radio and with orders to guard the site, Wendy must fight the urge to run. (Thriller) - 2019

actionmax.us.title: Scream
actionmax.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

actionmax.us.title: Shut In
actionmax.us.description: Mary Portman is a widowed child psychologist who lives in isolation in rural Maine. The horrific car accident that killed her husband also left her 18-year-old stepson Stephen in a bedridden, catatonic state, leaving him completely dependent on her. When one of Portman's young patients vanishes without a trace, she becomes convinced that the boy's ghost is now in the house as a dangerous ice storm starts to wreak havoc outside. (Thriller) - 2016

actionmax.us.title: The Watchers

actionmax.us.title: Trap

actionmax.us.title: Black Butterfly

After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (Thriller) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: Super Troopers 2

Jessan. The wacky quintet must provide law enforcement for a French Canadian town that's transitioning to U.S. sovereignty. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties, a smuggling ring and a 1,300-pound bear. (Comedy) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: Godzilla

Revealing a surprising paternal streak, Godzilla tries to teach his much smaller progeny how to use his powers. The father/son team must then battle giant insects, including praying mantises and a formidable spider. Can Godzilla protect his curious tyke from the gargantuan bugs? (Science fiction) - 1967

actionmax.us.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai

In the spirit of the samurai, he has pledged his loyalty to a small time mobster named Louie (John Tormey) who saved his life many years before. (Crime drama) - 1999

actionmax.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
actionmax.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (War, Historical drama) - 1987

sbssydney.au.title: Paul O'Grady: For the Love of Dogs
sbssydney.au.description: Paul helps a chihuahua-pug cross who's returned to Battersea for a second time, after her owner passed away. He also meets a lovable bulldog called Donald with a long list of ailments. (Special Interest)

sbssydney.au.title: Dinosaur With Stephen Fry - When Dinosaurs Ruled The Earth
sbssydney.au.description: Stephen Fry finds himself in the Early Cretaceous period, 125 million years ago. As the continents shift, dinosaurs flourish in different habitats and climates. (Special Interest)

sbssydney.au.title: Icons Of Auto - Jeep
sbssydney.au.description: Jeep's story begins in World War II and grows into an automotive legend. This documentary charts the rise of the iconic brand and its lasting influence on off-road vehicles. (Special Interest)

sbssydney.au.title: Compass Points from PBS News - Sunday 22 November 2026
sbssydney.au.description: Join PBS News Hour's Nick Schifrin and leading experts as they analyse prominent international affairs topics and their impact on America today. (News)

sbssydney.au.title: PBS Washington Week With The Atlantic - Sunday 22 November 2026
sbssydney.au.description: PBS Washington Week with The Atlantic is the longest-running primetime news and public affairs program on television. (News)

sbssydney.au.title: Beautiful Game Changers - Sulaiman Zandinan: Against The Odds
sbssydney.au.description: Yazidi refugee Sulaiman Zandinan survived IS captivity and rebuilt his life in Australia, where football gave him purpose, community and a path to refereeing. (Special Interest)

sbssydney.au.title: Speedweek
sbssydney.au.description: Speedweek is a comprehensive motorsport show that covers many forms of Australian and International motorsport - made specifically for speed enthusiasts. (Sports)

sbssydney.au.title: ISU Figure Skating Highlights - Grand Prix 3, China
sbssydney.au.description: All the best moments from the ISU Figure Skating Grand Prix Cup of China 2026, held in Shenzhen, China. (Sports)

sbssydney.au.title: Capturing Kennedy
sbssydney.au.description: Experience the untold story of JFK's personal photographer, Jacques Lowe, and the images that shaped Kennedy's Camelot. (Special Interest)

sbssydney.au.title: SBS World News
sbssydney.au.description: Latest reports and analysis of major national and international news of the day from Australia's only world news service. (News)

sbssydney.au.title: Richard E. Grant's Very Modern Odyssey - Corfu
sbssydney.au.description: Richard's final leg of his modern Odyssey brings him to Corfu, where he receives a hero's welcome and enjoys the bounties of this gem of an island before finally landing on Odysseus' home: Ithaca. (Special Interest)

sbssydney.au.title: Secrets of the Assyrian Empire
sbssydney.au.description: Archaeologists uncover lost Assyrian cities and vast engineering works, revealing how the world's first superpower harnessed water, transformed landscapes, and built a mighty empire. (Special Interest)

sbssydney.au.title: Caral - Sacred City In The Andes
sbssydney.au.description: 200 kilometres north of today's Peruvian capital Lima lies the first real city in the Americas, which was built 5000 years ago. Archaeologist Ruth Shady explore the ancient cradle of Andean culture. (Special Interest)

sbssydney.au.title: Ancient Superstructures - Tikal - The Jungle City
sbssydney.au.description: This episode sheds light on Tikal, one of the largest archaeological sites and urban centres of pre-Columbian Mayan civilisation. Tikal was the capital of the most powerful kingdom built by the Maya. (Special Interest)

sbssydney.au.title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
sbssydney.au.description: Brad Pitt and Academy Award winner Cate Blanchett star in F. Scott Fitzgerald's story of the life and loves of a man experiencing his life backwards. (Drama)

sbssydney.au.title: A Cold War of Spies - A Cold War Of Spies
sbssydney.au.description: In 1938, German physicists discover that atoms can be split and releasing tremendous energy. It is about nothing less than the ultimate weapon, which can destroy entire cities in one blow. (Special Interest)

sbssydney.au.title: A Cold War of Spies - Spies In The Skies
sbssydney.au.description: This is the first US aerial spy flights, the creation of NATO, and the first exchange of spies in captivity. Ending with the first spy satellites that made it possible to se the whole world in detail. (Special Interest)

sbssydney.au.title: Bamay - Kambuwal, Guuwa & Gayiri Country
sbssydney.au.description: A slow TV showcase of the stunning landscapes found in Kambuwal, Guuwa and Gayiri Country. (Special Interest)

sbssydney.au.title: Destination Flavour China Bitesize - Black Sesame Tangyuan
sbssydney.au.description: All the best moments and bits from Destination Flavour China, led by famed chef and author Adam Liaw. (Special Interest)

sbssydney.au.description: English news from Japan's Broadcasting Corporation, NHK, delivering the latest in business, technology, health, environmental and world news. (News)

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School: Sensational Senses
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S378 E2 Listen and Balance Alex, Rachael and Vanessa, along with Auslan Translator Julia, learn all about the senses of sound and balance. Rachael teaches yoga, they make popping popcorn, and the toys listen to a thunderstorm.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Piggy Builders
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E29 Potluck Picnic Wilf thinks he's been left out of a picnic, so he sulks and builds a huge tower. The Piggies must convince him to join them before the tower collapses.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E9 The Treasure Of El Bravo After Enrique steals the heart of El Bravo, there's only one person who can help Santi and crew save the day: Tomas's younger sister, Prima Tina!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S0 E6 Peppa Pig: Peppa's Pumpkin Party Daddy Pig is throwing a special party. Everyone is invited, and they are all dressing in scary costumes. Peppa is a witch, George is a dinosaur, Rebecca Rabbit is a carrot gone bad!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig: The Golden Boots
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: Mrs Duck seems to have taken a liking to Peppa's golden boots and runs away with them! Can Peppa track down the golden boots before the big puddle jump competition?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Tree Of Wisdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E1 The Rattlin' Bog Dance along with him and the Little Tree of Wisdom and then learn about hula hooping! Can you shake your hips and give it a go? And don't miss the remix of the hit song 'The Rattlin' Bog'!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Nikhil & Jay
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E15 Nikhil and Jay and the Lucky Striker When Jay plays carrom with Ammamma's lucky striker he can finally beat Amma! But when Jay loses the lucky striker his winning streak ends. Nikhil has a plan to help his brother!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Millie Magnificent
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E41 The Most Magnificent Pet Show Millie, Ben and Maya set out to teach Ying Ying a flying trick for the pet show in the park.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Stan & Gran
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E12 Hole in the Fence Strange holes in garden fences are popping up all over Porthole and Stink has gone missing! Stan and Gran spy a mystery and decide to investigate.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Miffy and Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E37 Mini Miffy Miffy's delight at being imitated by Baby Bun turns to frustration when his constant mimicry interferes with her dance recital practice, leading her on a journey to understand the joys and challenges of being a big sister!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E31 Mayor Mittens When Mayor Sourdough appoints Mittens as mayor of Kibble Corners (just while he takes a nap, mind you) everything goes wrong very fast.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E32 Puppy Party Pants worries that having adoptive bunny parents might not make him puppy enough for a puppy party.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E7 Simon's Rosy Arrangement Simon is crafting a floral arrangement for Dorothy the Dinosaur, but his roses vanish when he steps away to get some water. Caterina calls Fiore Enzo, the detective specialist for help!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mini Kids
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E6 Today Fantus meets a pigeon, a rat and a badger.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Thomas & Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E9 Percy's Lucky Bell When Thomas borrows Percy's lucky bell for a dangerous delivery, Thomas isn't careful and loses the bell.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E12 Grandpa Pig's Metal Detector When George loses his wind-up robot's metal key, Grandpa Pig uses his metal detector to find it and finds a lot of other things on the way.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E13 World Book Day It is World Book Day at playgroup but Peppa has so many favourite books she just cannot decide which to go as.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E25 Shaun The Farmer The Farmer is sick in bed, so, with Bitzer playing nurse-maid, it's down to Shaun to handle the daily chores around the farm - with disastrous results.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E5 Chillipede Chase Split chases a glowing Chillipede into the depths of the Spooky Forest and gets lost inside an overgrown tree-root maze, where the only way out is to follow the sounds of Ginger and the other Baby Pea-Rexes.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E1 Giants in the Meadow Lucy's dad is digging up the meadow and the Little Kingdom is in danger.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 Hectic Robot When a robotic toy duck is left at the restaurant, Flower becomes obsessed. Meanwhile, Flour the cat struggles to compete with the quacking newcomer for her attention.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E26 Tiny Trouble When Cat Burglar shrinks Buddy on his way to steal musical instruments, Buddy learns that he doesn't have to be big to be super.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E45 The Kitty Cat Caper Bonnie's cat tricks the crew into thinking he's a good pirate, but then they realize he's actually after their treasure.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: PJ Masks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E23 Gekko Vs Armavillian Desperate to prove himself, Gekko recruits Armadylan for extra training.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Octonauts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E20 The Octonauts And Hammerhead Sharks The Octonauts study a group of baby hammerhead sharks, as they hunt on their own for the first time and poke their noses into trouble.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E38 The Sand Castle Badge It's a lovely warm day for the beach. The squirrels learn how to make sand castles. They are doing such a good job that Jon and Nigel the crabs ask if the squirrels could work together to build them a new home.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E12 Dad Rescue When Frizzy's dad gets into trouble in the mountains, Frizzy steps up to lead the rescue mission and save the day!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fireman Sam
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S13 E6 Too Many Peas, Too Many Plugs When Dilys overloads a socket at the Cut Price Store and starts a fire, Mandy learns that every job on the Fire Rescue team is the most important job!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Nikhil & Jay
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E48 Nikhil and Jay and the Sneezies When Amma gets the sneezies, Nikhil and Jay are worried that it's Max's fault. They try to stop their cat from being sent away.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E4 What's My Number? Welcome to the game show where you don't count, you see the amount! Join the Numberblocks and learn how to recognise numbers of things without counting them.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Makery
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E13 Laundry Day Nim makes a sock gobbling monster by recycling an old box. Once the washing is done, she cooks focaccia flowers and creates a puppet mouse out of old clothes.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fizzy And Suds
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E20 Cows Fizzy and Suds spend time with some gorgeous country cows and even see them being milked. It's also showtime - and our bubbly friends get to meet some prize-winners. MOO MOOOOO!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E18 Everyday Helpers: 3 Abi and Luke meet Ben, a friendly and helpful nurse! Luke uses craft materials to make his own stethoscope, and Jemima visits Dr Kiya at hospital for an x-ray! Through The Windows, we see more medical workers in an animation.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Highway Rat
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: An animated swash-buckler based on the much-loved children's book written by Julia Donaldson and illustrated by Axel Scheffler. The tale of a greedy rat who craves buns and biscuits, but comes to a sticky end.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Little J And Big Cuz
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E1 Two Truths Little J is torn between Ms Chen and Nanna's knowledge.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Andy and the Band
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E2 Dinosaur Football It's time to get back to Rock Star School. But with Evil Aliens, Dinosaurs, Football and Cheesy Puffs, Andy faces a tough task to keep everyone from getting distracted.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Dodge's Pup School
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 The Class Star Dodge is eager to win the Class Star award, but how will he out shine Cherry the superstar at everything? Dodge discovers that the real key to winning the Class Star award is by trying his best.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E17 Sleepyhead Dirk promises to read Flower and Flour a bedtime story but when he's too tired to continue, Flower has to step in and invent her own bedtime story.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E20 Sensory Garden Hannah works with two brothers to create a garden that delights all of the senses. Alfie is vision impaired and loves being active and playing, so they create a garden of games he can enjoy with his brother, William.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S10 E5 Granny Sheep Moves In Suzy's grandma, Granny Sheep, moves into her house for the first time ever.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S8 E6 Cardboard Boxes Peppa and her friends have fun playing with boxes.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: It's Andrew!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E22 Big BIG Lifty Pod Andrew's fear of heights stops him from riding the Lifty Pod - but he doesn't want to miss out on hill sliding with his friends. So, when the littlecorns share how they face their fears, Andrew finds a way to be brave, too.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Thomas & Friends: Sodor Sings Together
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: In preparation for the big Sodor Sings Festival - the biggest musical event on the - the engines are hard at work to make the night one to remember.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Zog
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E26 Gadabout Blabbermouth Winton doesn't want anyone to know about his tummy troubles but Gadabout struggles to keep the news to himself.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: MaeBee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 Mae, Bee and the Bearded Bake While helping at Lesley's bakery, Mae, Bee and friends eat some magical buns of ageing, becoming 500yrs old. A rare four-leaf clover is the only cure, that's if they can catch it!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superbuns
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E31 Moment of Tooth After reading comics, Buns is convinced a super carrot will give her superpowers. But rescuing her sister Blossom's lost tooth is what makes her a true superhero!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Little Lunch
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E7 The Milk Bar Rory has forgotten his lunch, again, and the other children have had enough. They refuse to give him any more of their food. Rory is starving and, in desperation, decides to go to the milk bar.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Crookhaven

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Are You Afraid of the Dark?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Secret Life Of Bees
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 Steve finds out about the importance of Britain's wild bees and discovers exactly how the National Bee Unit are trying to eradicate the dreaded Asian hornet - a bee-eating machine - from the UK.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mythbusters: There's Your Problem!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E7 Zapped The MythBusters test if you can be electrocuted by lightning while talking on the phone; if a stun-gun could use water instead of wires; and if peeing on the electrified rail of a subway line could give you a fatal shock.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Slow Mo Guys' Big Adventures

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Robot Wars

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Young Sheldon

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: BTN High

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E38 Cruisin' For a Losin' May decides to use Bulbasaur in the Rubello Town Contest. Will its lack of experience cost her a ribbon?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Dragon Ball Super

But apparently not even the gods are allowed to meddle with the past. Bulma and Future Trunks might have a bit of explaining to do.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E12 Crocoduel Because of a plan thought up by Marinette, Shadow Moth akumatizes two villains. Ladybug and Cat Noir will need help to stop the evil duo!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Total Dramarama

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Malory Towers
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E9 The Strong Heart Clarissa receives a letter from her father, he is writing to inform her that he has sold her pony, Merrylegs, because Clarissa isn't well enough to ride anymore. Clarissa is devastated, she didn't even get to say goodbye!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The InBESTigators
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E24 The Case Of The Copy Cat Ava is selected to deliver a speech at the town hall, but when she is accused of stealing it, Maudie must prove her innocence.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E9 The Mind of Evil: Episode 5 The Master forms an uneasy alliance with the Doctor so that between them they can subdue the Keller Machine which is now out of control.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E10 The Mind of Evil: Episode 6 The Keller Machine breaks free of the Doctor’s restraining device and the Doctor has no choice but to turn the parasite against the Master.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E11 The Claws of Axos: Episode 1 Axos lands on Earth. The Axons ask only to be allowed to repair their damaged ship and offer the gift of the miraculous Axonite in return. But the Axons aren’t all that they seem.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E12 The Claws of Axos: Episode 2 The Master is in league with the Axons who intend to consume the Earth. The Doctor subjects Axonite to tests and discovers the terrible truth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E13 The Claws of Axos: Episode 3 The Axons reveal their true nature and attempt to obtain the secret of time travel. Meanwhile, the Master, forced to work for UNIT, concocts a plan to strike back at Axos.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E14 The Claws of Axos: Episode 4 With Axos poised to destroy the world, the Doctor appears to switch sides and allies himself with the Master. Together they plan to escape the Earth, leaving it to Axos.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E1 Terror of the Autons: Episode 1 The Master, a renegade Time Lord and a rival of the Doctor’s, arrives on Earth and paves the way for an invasion by the insidious Nestene Consciousness.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E2 Terror of the Autons: Episode 2 The Doctor follows the Master’s trail to the circus. Meanwhile, the Master has used his hypnotic powers to take control of a plastics factory where he creates the deadly Autons.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E3 Terror of the Autons: Episode 3 The Doctor and the Brigadier trace the Master to the plastics factory but they are too late. The only clue to the Master’s plans is a single plastic daffodil.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E4 Terror of the Autons: Episode 4 The Doctor and UNIT race to prevent the Master from broadcasting the deadly activation signal and opening the channel for the Nestene’s arrival on Earth.

BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E6 The Mind of Evil: Episode 2 A full scale riot takes place at the Prison and Jo is taken hostage. Meanwhile, at the World Peace conference, the Chinese delegate’s aid prepares to kill the American delegate.

BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E7 The Mind of Evil: Episode 3 The Master is behind the Keller Machine and uses it to recruit the rioting inmates at Stangmoor Prison. He plans to capture a missile and fire it at the World Peace Conference.

BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E13 The Claws of Axos: Episode 3 The Axons reveal their true nature and attempt to obtain the secret of time travel. Meanwhile, the Master, forced to work for UNIT, concocts a plan to strike back at Axos.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E14 The Claws of Axos: Episode 4 With Axos poised to destroy the world, the Doctor appears to switch sides and allies himself with the Master. Together they plan to escape the Earth, leaving it to Axos.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E8 The Daleks: The Ambush Pretending to be a Dalek, Ian finds that that he is trapped inside the casing. The Doctor, Susan and Barbara have no choice but to abandon Ian as the real Daleks arrive and attack.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E5 The Daleks: The Dead Planet The travellers venture out on to the surface of a new world. Everything is dead but beyond a petrified jungle they see a huge metal city which the Doctor is determined to explore.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E7 The Daleks: The Escape Fearful of a Thal attack, the Daleks force Susan to trick the Thals. Realising that the Daleks are planning an ambush, the four travellers try to escape and warn the Thals.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E9 The Daleks: The Expedition Ian and Barbara join a Thal expedition that will penetrate the Dalek city from the unguarded mountains behind it. Their journey is a dangerous one and not all will survive.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E10 The Daleks: The Ordeal The Doctor and Susan are once again taken prisoner by the Daleks. In the mountains, Ian, Barbara and the Thals must negotiate a vast chasm to reach the city.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E11 The Daleks: The Rescue The Thals and the time travellers attack the Daleks from all sides as the Daleks start the countdown to release deadly doses of radiation into the atmosphere.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E6 The Daleks: The Survivors Looking for Barbara, the Doctor, Ian and Susan discover that they have exposed to lethal doses of radiation. The travellers are confronted by the city’s inhabitants – the Daleks!

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E13 The Edge of Destruction: The Brink of Disaster As the power of the TARDIS threatens to escape and destroy the ship, the travellers become increasingly paranoid and hostile towards each other.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E12 The Edge of Destruction: The Edge of Destruction The TARDIS is suspended in space and the Doctor, Ian, Barbara and Susan are confused and frightened by a series of inexplicable events.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E25 The Keys of Marinus: Sentence of Death Arriving in the city of Millennius, Ian is put on trial for murder. The Doctor takes on the role of defence counsel and must prove Ian's innocence or he will be executed.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E26 The Keys of Marinus: The Keys of Marinus The Doctor solves the murder mystery and finds the final missing key. With Ian now free, the travellers return to the island only to discover that Arbitan has been murdered.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E23 The Keys of Marinus: The Screaming Jungle Ian and Barbara find a temple in the middle of a hostile jungle. Inside is the ailing Darrius, keeper of one of the keys. As Darrius dies he gives Ian a clue to find the key.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E21 The Keys of Marinus: The Sea of Death The TARDIS lands on a remote island, surrounded by a sea of acid. They meet Arbitan, keeper of the Conscience of Marinus who forces the travellers to go in search of five keys.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E24 The Keys of Marinus: The Snows of Terror In a snowy wasteland, Vasor, an unscrupulous trapper, imprisons the travellers in a frozen cavern inside a mountain. There they find one of the keys frozen in a block of ice.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E3 Terror of the Autons: Episode 3 The Doctor and the Brigadier trace the Master to the plastics factory but they are too late. The only clue to the Master’s plans is a single plastic daffodil.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E4 Terror of the Autons: Episode 4 The Doctor and UNIT race to prevent the Master from broadcasting the deadly activation signal and opening the channel for the Nestene’s arrival on Earth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E8 The Daleks: The Ambush Pretending to be a Dalek, Ian finds that that he is trapped inside the casing. The Doctor, Susan and Barbara have no choice but to abandon Ian as the real Daleks arrive and attack.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Living
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: This is the story of an ordinary man, reduced by years of oppressive office routine to a shadow existence, who at the eleventh hour makes a supreme effort to turn his dull life into something wonderful. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Resistance
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Before becoming the world-famous mime Marcel Marceau, aspiring Jewish actor Marcel Mangel (Jesse Eisenberg) joins the French Resistance to save thousands of orphaned children from the Nazis. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: I Accidentally Wrote a Book
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: The inspiring story of 12-year-old Nina, who discovers the healing power of writing, and through it embarks on a journey of self discovery and enlightenment. (Kids & Family)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Lassie: A New Adventure
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Lassie teams up with Flo and new friends to solve the mysterious disappearance of pedigree dogs, using her sharp instincts to uncover the truth and save the missing pets. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Dancing At Lughnasa
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A young boy tells the story of growing up in a fatherless home with his unmarried mother and four spinster aunts in 1930s Ireland. (Meryl Streep, Catherine McCormack, Rhys Ifans). (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Russian Ark
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Shot in one fluid shot, this film travels through the Hermitage in St Petersburg using art and history to create a visual feast. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Non-Stop
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Air Marshal Bill Marks receives cryptic text messages during a flight demanding the airline to transfer $150 million into an off-shore account ... or a passenger will be killed every 20 minutes. (Action & Adventure)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Argo
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Ben Affleck helms and stars this Oscar®-winning film based on a true story about the CIA life-or-death covert operation to rescue six American diplomats trapped in Teheran in 1979. “Exfiltration” specialist agent Tony Mendez (Affleck) arrives in Iran under the guise of a Hollywood producer seeking exotic locations and fools local authorities to rescue the American citizens before it is too late. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Daddio
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A young woman (Dakota Johnson) and a cabbie (Sean Penn) share a remarkable journey in New York City. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Sanctuary

To save the gym, Peter and a ragtag group of Average Joe's members and employees enter a dodgeball contest with a big cash prize.
